mapQuery: Riverwalk House B&B, Oughterard, Co. Galway

en: Riverwalk House is a Fáilte Ireland 4-star B&B in a quiet spot by the river, just a three-minute walk from the village of Oughterard.
Each of our three en-suite rooms is individually decorated, with tea and coffee, TV, hairdryer and toiletries. Mornings start with a full Irish or continental breakfast.
We’re a perfect base for anglers on Lough Corrib, walkers heading into Connemara, and anyone exploring Galway and the west.
ga: Is B&B 4 réalta Fáilte Ireland é Riverwalk House, in áit chiúin cois abhann, siúlóid trí nóiméad ó shráidbhaile Uachtar Ard.

Tá gach ceann dár dtrí sheomra en suite maisithe ar a bhealach féin, le tae agus caife, teilifís, triomadóir gruaige agus earraí folctha. Tosaíonn an mhaidin le bricfeasta Éireannach iomlán nó bricfeasta ilchríochach.
Is bunáit iontach muid d’iascairí ar Loch Coirib, do shiúlóirí ag dul isteach i gConamara, agus do dhuine ar bith atá ag taiscéaladh na Gaillimhe agus an iarthair.
